result.description: AI meeting recorder that captures, transcribes and summarizes calls, with clips, AI notes and workspace search.
result.auth_detail: Personal Access Token (user-scoped, grain_pat_ prefix, sent as Bearer), Workspace Access Token (admin-generated, workspace-wide), and OAuth2 auth-code (PKCE per third-party reports) for distributed integrations. The OAuth app registration process was not confirmed.
result.access_detail: Personal tokens are available on every plan, including Free. Workspace tokens need a Business or Enterprise plan and an admin. OAuth for apps distributed to other users is described, but how to get client credentials was not found, so a registration or approval step may apply. No sandbox exists.
result.api_notes: Public API v2 at developers.grain.com. It covers recordings, transcripts, workspace data and webhooks, with a limit of 300 requests per minute per token. v1 (beta) was sunset in September 2026. Third parties say a Public-Api-Version header is required. The exact endpoint count was not verified because I did not read developers.grain.com directly. Some sources say v2 is read-heavy.

evidence.quote: The token has the same permissions as the user who generated it.
Required if you are building an integration to distribute to others.
Not for personal API access, which is available on every plan, including Free.
Only workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can generate API tokens for the workspace.
The v1 (beta) API was sunset in September 2026. Use v2 for all integrations.
The API allows 300 requests per minute per token.
Grain's MCP server uses OAuth and HTTPS.
Grain's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server gives AI assistants direct access to your meetings, transcripts, AI notes, and workspace data.
